mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pf.quota_principal(user_id) VALUES(#{user}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT u.id AS user_id,u.platform_admin AS administrator,u.status='ACTIVE' AS active,clock_timestamp() AS now FROM pf.quota_principal q JOIN pf.app_user u ON u.id=q.user_id WHERE q.user_id=#{user} FOR UPDATE OF q
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pf.quota_bucket(user_id,metric,window_start,window_end) VALUES(#{user},#{metric},#{start},#{end}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT consumed,reserved,version FROM pf.quota_bucket WHERE user_id=#{user} AND metric=#{metric} AND window_start=#{start}
SELECT COALESCE(sum(reserved),0) FROM pf.quota_reservation WHERE user_id=#{user} AND metric=#{metric} AND window_start<>#{start} AND status IN ('RESERVED','UNKNOWN')
SELECT call_id,metric,user_id,window_start,reserved,actual,status FROM pf.quota_reservation WHERE call_id=#{call} ORDER BY metric
mapper.update: UPDATE pf.quota_bucket SET reserved=reserved+#{amount},version=version+1 WHERE user_id=#{user} AND metric=#{metric} AND window_start=#{start}
UPDATE pf.quota_reservation SET actual=#{actual},status=#{state} WHERE call_id=#{call} AND metric=#{metric} AND status IN ('RESERVED','UNKNOWN')
UPDATE pf.quota_bucket SET reserved=reserved-#{reserved},consumed=consumed+#{actual},version=version+1 WHERE user_id=#{user} AND metric=#{metric} AND window_start=#{start} AND reserved>=#{reserved}
UPDATE pf.quota_reservation SET status='UNKNOWN' WHERE call_id=#{call} AND status='RESERVED'
mapper.select: SELECT id,metric,limit_value,timezone,version FROM pf.quota_policy WHERE subject_user_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM #{user,jdbcType=OTHER} AND metric=#{metric}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pf.quota_policy(id,subject_user_id,metric,limit_value,timezone) VALUES(#{id},#{change.userId,jdbcType=OTHER},#{change.metric},#{change.limit,jdbcType=BIGINT},#{change.timezone}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE pf.quota_policy SET limit_value=#{change.limit,jdbcType=BIGINT},timezone=#{change.timezone},version=version+1,updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE id=#{id} AND version=#{change.expectedVersion}
mapper.select: SELECT request_hash,after_json FROM pf.quota_policy_audit WHERE command_id=#{command}
